name: cholecalciferol + sodium fluoride
uses: How to Use Fill dropper to appropriate line and dispense with a single squeeze of the dropper bulb. The full dose will be given. It is normal for a small amount to remain in the tip of the dropper. Do not accept if tamper evident box seal is broken or missing. The manufacturer of this product requires that it be dispensed only under the order of a physician or licensed medical practitioner.
